base_member_text: [L6-L15] (LOW/documentation-quality) The introductory description contains multiple typos and an incomplete phrase (`is spacepars`, `mnemonic is know`, `distribute`), making the generated-variable contract harder to interpret.

[L20-L25,L63-L70,L83-L86] (MED/build-contract) The generator workflow describes templates and generated files but does not state whether checked-in generated files must be regenerated, how stale outputs are detected, or which Makefile target enforces consistency.
[L97-L103] (LOW/portability) The non-make example hard-codes an `f90` compiler command without specifying required Fortran standard/features or the compiler options needed by this generator.

audit_member_text: [L41-L46] (LOW/initialization-contract) The scalar-allocation description requires instantiation before array allocation but does not state that dimension scalars also need defined values before they are used as bounds.

[L63-L70,L102-L103] (LOW/interactive-input-contract) The final ./makeincludes example does not provide the end-of-file that the earlier empty-standard-input example supplies, so an interactive invocation may wait for input instead of generating all files.
